description: Header file defining wrapper classes for Python types in pybind11, including type hints like List, Dict, Union, Optional, and related template classes for explicit type annotations in Python bindings.

classes.name: Dict
classes.description: Wrapper class for Python dict with key and value type annotations.

classes.name: List
classes.description: Wrapper class for Python list with element type annotation.

classes.description: Wrapper class for Python set with element type annotation.

classes.description: Wrapper class for Python iterable with element type annotation.

classes.name: Iterator
classes.description: Wrapper class for Python iterator with element type annotation.

classes.name: Callable
classes.description: Wrapper class for Python callable with specified signature.

classes.name: Type
classes.description: Wrapper class for Python type objects with type annotation.

classes.name: Union

classes.name: Optional
classes.description: Wrapper class for optional Python type.

classes.name: Final
classes.description: Wrapper class for final Python type annotation.

classes.name: ClassVar

classes.description: Wrapper class for type guard annotations.
